content.value_statement: Complex cloud networks need secure, repeatable design and careful troubleshooting. This skill guides architecture, diagnostics, optimization, and documentation across cloud and hybrid environments.
actual_capabilities: Designs VPC, virtual network, peering, VPN, and transit gateway architectures.
Reviews load balancing, DNS, CDN, and failover approaches for reliability.
Guides SSL/TLS, PKI, mTLS, firewall, and zero-trust network decisions.
Troubleshoots connectivity, latency, packet loss, DNS, and service mesh issues.
Plans monitoring, flow logs, alerting, capacity, and network documentation.
limitations: Does not replace vendor-specific certification or production change approval.
Cannot verify live network state without user-provided data or tool output.
Network scanning guidance must be limited to authorized systems and approved scopes.
The analyzed package only includes SKILL.md; referenced external playbooks may be unavailable.

use_cases.title: Plan a Cloud Network
use_cases.description: Create VPC, subnet, routing, peering, and gateway designs that meet security and availability requirements.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Service Connectivity
use_cases.description: Diagnose DNS, TLS, load balancer, service mesh, and packet loss issues using structured evidence.

use_cases.title: Harden Network Access
use_cases.description: Review segmentation, firewall rules, zero-trust patterns, VPNs, and monitoring controls for compliance needs.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Network Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this network design for reliability and security. Context: [cloud], [regions], [subnets], [traffic flows], [constraints]. Give prioritized recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Connectivity Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Help troubleshoot this connectivity issue. Source: [source]. Destination: [destination]. Symptoms: [errors]. Recent changes: [changes]. Evidence: [logs or command output].

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Global Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a global traffic and CDN strategy for [application]. Include DNS routing, load balancing, caching, TLS, failover, monitoring, and rollout checks.

prompt_templates.title: Build Zero-Trust Multi-Cloud Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a zero-trust multi-cloud network plan for [AWS/Azure/GCP environments]. Cover identity, segmentation, peering, service mesh, audit logging, and disaster recovery.

output_examples.input: Review a proposed AWS VPC with public web tier, private app tier, NAT gateways, and cross-region failover.
output: Flags single points of failure in NAT placement and regional routing.
Recommends private subnet boundaries, route table checks, and failover tests.
Adds monitoring requirements for flow logs, health checks, and gateway metrics.

output_examples.input: Troubleshoot intermittent TLS errors behind an application load balancer.
output: Separates DNS, certificate chain, listener policy, and backend health checks.
Suggests evidence to collect from logs, client errors, and certificate validation.
Prioritizes likely causes and proposes rollback-safe verification steps.

output_examples.input: Create a zero-trust network plan for workloads split across AWS, Azure, and Kubernetes.
output: Defines identity-based access, segmentation, and service-to-service controls.
Maps cloud peering, VPN, and service mesh responsibilities.
Includes audit logging, policy review, and disaster recovery validation.

best_practices: Provide topology, traffic flows, cloud provider, and recent changes before asking for guidance.
Validate recommendations in staging and follow approved change windows for production networks.
Limit diagnostic or scanning activity to systems you own or have written authorization to assess.
anti_patterns: Requesting broad scans of third-party networks or unknown public IP ranges.
Applying routing, firewall, or certificate changes without rollback and monitoring plans.
Sharing secrets, private keys, full packet captures, or customer data in prompts.

faq.question: Can this skill create network diagrams?
faq.answer: It can outline diagrams and describe components, but the final drawing depends on your chosen diagramming tool.

faq.question: Does it run network commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and can interpret outputs that you choose to share.

faq.question: Can it help with AWS, Azure, and GCP?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers common networking services, routing patterns, load balancers, VPNs, DNS, and monitoring across major cloud providers.

faq.question: Is nmap guidance allowed?
faq.answer: Only for authorized assets and approved scopes. Do not use it for third-party reconnaissance.

faq.question: Can it replace a network engineer?
faq.answer: No. It supports design and troubleshooting, but production decisions still need qualified review and change control.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Share the cloud provider, topology, CIDRs, traffic flows, symptoms, logs, constraints, and recent change history.
